text: Well, that tourist came up here and wanted gasoline.
And he said, your aircraft around here flies awfully low.
I said, well, how is that, sir?
He said, well, it's like knocking me off the road out there.
He said, it must have been in trouble.
He said a policeman was going to it.
So I asked him, was it the helicopter?
He said, if it was, it was a funny-looking one.
So he went on about his affairs, and I was making up the bank deposits
It was for the bank at 15 to 6, and that was the same time he was here.
And the next morning, it dawned on me that the time element was the same time that the
tourist was in here that Zamora went to that object that was on the ground there.
And I called the radio station, told them Zamora was not telling a lie because the tourist
had seen something and didn't think much of it.
And he saw the policeman also going to the object that was on the ground, which was a UFO.
